rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beaconing patterns in memory or traffic"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2d 73 6c 70 69 74 2d 78 6d 6c } // '-split-xml' common in CS scripts
        $b = "user-agent: beacon/" nocase
        $c = { 68 74 74 70 3a 2f 2f [0-3] 63 6f 6d 6d 61 6e 64 2e 78 6d 6c } // 'http://*/command.xml'
    condition:
        any of ($a, $b, $c)
}
